actual_file_location.note: Not duplicated into canonical NEXUS. Referenced via the MODEL_PATH environment variable (see app/config.py::load_settings), consistent with the NEXUS external-first storage policy: this file already resides on external storage and duplicating it locally would serve no operational purpose.

verification.verified_during: DAT.AI Phase A+B donor verification (2026-08-27), re-confirmed Phase C
findings: conv1.weight is bit-identical to torchvision IMAGENET1K_V1 -- the backbone has received no domain training on satellite imagery.
fc.bias statistics are consistent with fresh initialisation -- the 5-class head has not been trained.
Checkpoint accepts 3 input channels but the preprocessing contract supplies 4 (B02, B03, B04, B08).

enforcement.mechanism: app.ml.satellite_classifier.audit_checkpoint() overrides MODEL_PROMOTED_FOR_PRODUCTION=true when evidence shows the checkpoint is untrained -- configuration cannot promote a model the evidence rejects.
